headline: Apple reported that commercial paper outstanding decreased from $8.0 billion to $2.0 billion.
Apple repurchased 215 million shares for $61.8 billion during the nine months ended June 2026.
Apple said one customer represented 18% of total trade receivables.
Two manufacturing vendors represented 47% and 22% of Apple vendor non-trade receivables.
Apple requires credit support or collateral from certain customers to limit credit risk.
